q1_issues.issue: "shortages" and "shots" are bare plurals in an episodic clause, which the instruction set gives existential GROUP witnesses, but each is encoded as a singular sk_ witness, so the plurality is dropped.

(Inheritance pneumococcal_disease pneumococcal) exposes a relational, origin-naming adjective as a modifier genus, which is none of the three licensed modifier types (gradable, positional/cardinal, material).

q2_gaps: An absence/quantity noun's of-complement ("shortages OF shots"): it is neither a nominalization's object (there is no underlying verb "to shortage") nor a true relational noun taking Possession/PartOf, so no head is prescribed for it.

A coordinate hyphenated multi-disease compound ("diphtheria-tetanus-whooping cough", "measles-mumps-rubella"): the compound rules cover modifier+head only, and a coordination of three kinds with no head noun is unaddressed.
A scope/domain adverb ("nationally") has no licensed slot — the instruction set registers this and the parse correctly omits it, so the restriction to national scope is unrecoverable.

Existential "there were <state-noun>s": whether the state noun's witness carries the clause's tense/Time directly (as under the light-verb rule) or a copular/existential eventuality is reified is not stated.
notes: The five-way distributive replication over the coordinated disease list, the deictic constant last_year, the For obliques on the shot symbols, and the omission of "nationally" all follow the instruction set. Plurality is the main loss, and the pneumococcal modifier genus is the one over-emission.
